_comment: Buy-side origination: home services companies with >= $500K EBITDA.
BBB PROFILE PAGES ARE NOT REACHABLE. They sit behind a Cloudflare
challenge that plain HTTP, headless Chromium and a real Chrome under
automation all fail -- the same pages load fine in an ordinary browser
window, so it is the automation being blocked, not the network. That
means BBB's own headcount, years in business and accreditation are
unavailable. `detail: false` skips the attempt rather than spending
seconds per listing proving it again every morning. Set it true if BBB
relents.
So the size screen runs on APOLLO's headcount, which arrives with the
people-match you are already paying for. Nobody publishes EBITDA at this
scale; at home-services margins of 10-15%, $500K EBITDA implies roughly
$3.5-5M of revenue, about 20-30 employees. min_employees is 20.
The `screen` column is the first thing to read:
QUALIFIED      Apollo sized it and it clears the bar
REVIEW-UNSIZED Apollo has never indexed this company, so nothing sized
it. These are the sleepers -- the reason to scrape BBB
rather than query Apollo -- and they need your eye, not
a filter. They are NOT screened.
TOO-SMALL      sized, and under the bar
Rows are sorted in that order, so the top of the sheet is actionable.
No revenue ceiling -- the PE platform partners buy at many sizes.
MSP/IT is absent despite 5 partners wanting it: MSPs sell B2B and rarely
register with BBB, so those lists would be noise. That vertical needs an
Apollo-native search instead.
metros: national, largest first, since deal flow follows population. The
cursor advances every run and is remembered in .rotation-state.json.
